electronics_noise.provenance: Run3 first60% pretrigger-only effective covariance; not a signal impulse response

assumptions: 4x4 array and all 16 summed channels are an explicit initial hypothesis, not confirmed wiring.
50 ohm effective load, 3 V overvoltage and 29 ns recovery are placeholders; 53.2 V bias is NOT converted using typical breakdown voltage.
Constant PDE 0.30 and disabled dark/XT/AP are uncalibrated switches; zero does not mean absent in device.
Lowpass 256 ns = 50 ohm * 16 * 320 pF only if directly parallel; alternative summing networks require calibration.
Gamma decay times 679/3340 ns and approximate integrated fractions are literature starting values, not this crystal measurements; alpha fraction, light yield, spectrum, optics are hypotheses.
Source is a point in air; encapsulation and source active layer unspecified.
Microcells are uniformly mapped to 3584 effective cells/channel; exact masked-cell layout and electronic inter-channel coupling not represented.
evidence.confirmed: User 2026-10-27: 10 mm cube CsI(Tl), external PTFE tape, 5 um front Mylar, S13361-3050 series, multiple summed channels, no preamplifier; source distance unknown and authorized to scan.
evidence.fit_policy: Shared tau_fast/tau_slow and passive RC; separate source-dominant fractions. Am-dominant -> alpha is a testable hypothesis, not truth. No source distance was fitted. No preamplifier added.

joint_screening.normalization: Effective common light-yield scale at fixed gain/PDE, not a measured intrinsic light yield
joint_screening.range: 500 mV follows current X4 settings; association to historical BIN remains unconfirmed
joint_screening.source_geometry: Fitted candidate among declared scenarios; not recovered apparatus history

noise_model_update.limits: Finite-window stationary Gaussian approximation; does not reproduce transient weak pulses, non-Gaussian tails, run12 late noise changes, or infer the single-PE signal response.
noise_model_update.scope: Pretrigger-calibrated Gaussian FIR noise update; all optical, avalanche and signal-response parameters inherited without refitting.
